newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Telekom sell-off to begin in 1997 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Turk Telekom sell-off to begin in 1997 2nd half.

text.p: The first tranche of Turkey's state telecommunications company Turk Telekom will be privatised in the second half of 1997, the head of the country's privatisation administration (OIB) said on Wednesday.
OIB chairman Ismail Karakaya said in a speech that Turkey planned to sell an additional stake in the steel producer Eregli in domestic and international markets.
The sale of a 30-40 percent stake in Eregli is already being processed, while 51.66 percent is to remain in public ownership. The remaining 8.34-18.34 percent is to be sold off under the latest plan.

These two privatisations are key to the government's aim of speeding up sell-offs this year as a way of raising badly needed revenues. The government is aiming to raise $5 billion from privatisations this year.
Karakaya said revenues of $500 million were expected in January, when the sale of Etibank, split into three banks, is to be completed.
